shortDescription: Manage the HPE Nimble Storage user policies

options.name: allowed_attempts
options.description: Number of authentication attempts allowed before the user account is locked. Allowed range is [1, 10] inclusive. '0' indicates no limit.

options.name: digit
options.description: Number of numerical characters required in user passwords. Allowed range is [0, 255] inclusive.

options.name: lower
options.description: Number of lowercase characters required in user passwords. Allowed range is [0, 255] inclusive.

options.name: max_sessions
options.description: Maximum number of sessions allowed for a group. Allowed range is [10, 1000] inclusive.

options.name: min_length
options.description: Minimum length for user passwords. Allowed range is [8, 255] inclusive.

options.name: no_reuse
options.description: Number of times that a password must change before you can reuse a previous password. Allowed range is [1,20] inclusive.

options.name: previous_diff
options.description: Number of characters that must be different from the previous password. Allowed range is [1, 255] inclusive.

options.name: special
options.description: Number of special characters required in user passwords. Allowed range is [0, 255] inclusive.

options.name: upper
options.description: Number of uppercase characters required in user passwords. Allowed range is [0, 255] inclusive.
